name: Berbere-Spiced Pork Chop with Wakandan Chakalaka (Night 1)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Treasure · Worlds of Marvel (Quantum Encounter Night 1)
whyItWorks: Ethiopian berbere spice rub is loaded with cayenne/chili heat, fenugreek, and garlic, and Chakalaka is a spicy bean-and-tomato relish.
prepOrOrderInstructions: If ordering the pork chop, ask for it grilled plain with salt only and served with whipped Yukon potatoes instead of Chakalaka beans.
watchOuts: Beans, onions, and peppers in Chakalaka relish
